body: Commercial beverage photograph of amber iced tea being poured from a glass carafe into a clear cylindrical glass. Backlight reveals liquid clarity; freeze the thin pouring stream and a small believable splash with sharp droplets. Clean teal background. A small blank cream label faces camera without distortion. Macro advertising photography, 4:5 portrait. No words, no brand, no hands visible.
